text: AC Milan back-of-shirt sponsor Bitpanda is the consumer brand of the Bitpanda group, whose holding company Bitpanda Group AG is registered in Zurich, Switzerland (CHE-267.250.666). The group was founded in Vienna in 2014 by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, who sit on the holding's supervisory board; venture investors include Valar Ventures and partners of DST Global. No state or state-fund shareholder is named by any of the sources.
short: Bitpanda is the brand of Bitpanda Group AG, a privately held Swiss holding founded in Vienna in 2014 by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer….
